title.narrative: The overall objective is to conduct two scientific researches aimed at sustainable development of Northern Katpar and Upper Kayrakty tungsten deposits: (i) increase the extraction of tungsten from lowgrade and subeconomic ore deposits by laboratory testing of heap leaching technology for tungsten ore in a closed loop, thereby making the development of such types of deposits economically attractive; and (ii) implementation of a closedloop water resource management system in production, significantly reducing and preserving the use of water resources in the environmentally harmful tungsten production process. Below are the expected end results/deliverables to be provided by the Contractors for each of the assignments.
